skill_name: Modify the given code to print out the largest number in the list.
workflow:
nums = [3, 4, 9, 5]

# Assign largest_num to -infinity
largest_num = -float('inf')

# Iterate over nums
for num in nums:
    # Check if num is larger than largest_num
    if num > largest_num:
        # Assign num to largest_num
        largest_num = num

# Print out largest_num
print(largest_num)
